reasons.persona_fit: Speaks directly to an owner-operator in a calm, practical voice. Adheres strictly to the no-CTA rule and reinforces human review for financial approvals.
reasons.clarity: Immediately establishes the core idea and proceeds through a structured, logical sequence with unambiguous examples and plain terminology.
reasons.actionability: Provides a realistic next step: defining a plain-English rule, establishing human-in-the-loop thresholds, and asking a clear diagnostic question before automating.
reasons.factual_grounding: Contains no fabricated claims, metrics, or case studies. Respects all operating boundaries and keeps illustrative examples strictly hypothetical.
